secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_ID
secrets.description: Base44 app ID — identifies your app on the Base44 platform. Find it in the Base44 Builder/dashboard for this project.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_APP_BASE_URL
secrets.description: Your deployed Base44 app URL (e.g. https://your-app.base44.app). The Vite plugin proxies /api requests here so the local frontend can use the hosted backend.

secrets.name: VITE_BASE44_FUNCTIONS_VERSION
secrets.description: Optional — version tag for Base44 cloud functions. Leave blank to use the latest.
